name: Tregenna Castle
accommodation: Hotel rooms, hotel apartments, cottages and lodges
suitableFor: Families and groups wanting hotel or self-catering stays with facilities
beachAccess: On the hill above St Ives harbour
confirmedFeatures: 72-acre grounds, restaurant, bar, leisure facilities, beauty treatments
overview: A 72-acre resort high on the hill above St Ives, offering hotel rooms, apartments and self-catering cottages and lodges. It has a restaurant, a bar, leisure facilities and beauty treatments, and coastal walks run through the grounds. The town and its beaches, including Porthmeor, are below the resort.
surfTripFit: A good choice for a group or family who want space and facilities, with the St Ives beaches a short trip away.
